author: Corridor Crew
description:
Videos generated by artificial intelligence tools from Meta, Google, OpenAI, and more are now spreading on Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, and X at a rapid pace. 

Niko was invited to NBC News' TODAY to share some useful tips for spotting fake AI-generated videos.

Do you have some extra pointers that others should be looking for?
title: THIS is how YOU can spot AI content
